title: Date Calculator: Days Between Dates, Add or Subtract Time
description: Free date calculator: count the days between two dates, add or subtract years, months, weeks and days, and see weekdays, weekends and the day of the week.
lead: How many days until a deadline, a trip or a birthday? What date is 90 days from today? Enter two dates, or a start date and an amount of time, and get the answer with weekdays and weekends broken out.
